camel_example: aliyun ens UnassociateNetworkAcl --region cn-hangzhou --Resource.1.ResourceId 'n-5000' --NetworkAclId 'nacl-a2do9e413e0sp0000' --Resource.1.ResourceType Network --method POST --force
description_en: Invokes the UnassociateNetworkAcl operation to disassociate a network ACL from a network, which reverses the attach of the network ACL
description_zh: 调用UnassociateNetworkAcl接口，解绑定网络ACL与网络
kebab_example: aliyun ens unassociate-network-acl --network-acl-id nacl-a2do9e413e0sp0000 --resource ResourceId=n-5000 ResourceType=Network --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassociateNetworkAcl

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network ACL
parameters.help_zh: 要解绑关联资源的网络ACL的ID
parameters.name: network_acl_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the associated resource to disassociate
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the associated resource to disassociate. Valid values:
Network: network
fields.help_zh:
要解绑的关联资源类型。
取值：
Network 网络
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of resources to disassociate. Valid values of N: 1 to 30. The resources must be associated with the network ACL by calling the AssociateNetworkAcl operation, and the current association status must be BINDED
parameters.help_zh: 要解绑的资源列表，N 的取值为 1~30。资源须先通过 AccosicateNetworkAcl 绑定到网络 ACL，且当前绑定状态为 BINDED
parameters.name: resource
